ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible fluke surface, providing extreme contrast against the high-intensity (white) background; high-intensity pixels on the fluke are localized to specific scarring and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a solid, contiguous black field. High-contrast white geometric blobs include a series of parallel linear markings on the upper left lobe, a cluster of intersecting linear marks near the center-left trailing edge, and multiple small, circular white spots distributed across the distal and medial areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40-50 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency and high-amplitude serrations. The trailing edge boundary is highly irregular, featuring numerous sharp peaks and deep, jagged valleys along the entire length of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a strong convex curve sweeping upward and outward, terminating in narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated, high-contrast textured pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization). Multiple individual circular white-pixel clusters (circular scars) are scattered throughout the black ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least four parallel white linear marks on the upper left quadrant and a complex network of intersecting white linear marks near the center-left portion of the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on both lobe tips. Significant white rake marks and multiple circular 'cookie-cutter' scars across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge is exceptionally jagged and exhibits an unusual secondary deep indentation on the left lobe, proximal to the median notch.
